name: Beginner - British Rowing Go Row - Week 1
description: Official British Rowing beginner program entry. Very short 1-minute intervals with equal rest, designed for absolute beginners.

name: Beginner - Concept2 First Strokes
description: Very first rowing session from Concept2. Short 3-minute intervals with breaks to stretch and reset form between sets.

name: Beginner - British Rowing Go Row - Week 4
description: Progressed version from British Rowing with longer 5-minute work blocks. Builds aerobic base and confidence for sustained rowing.

name: Beginner - Technique Drills Circuit
description: Isolate parts of the rowing stroke using drills. Arms-only through full stroke, then pause drills for timing. Based on Concept2 drill recommendations.

name: Beginner - Concept2 Stroke Rate Explorer
description: Learn to change stroke rates deliberately while keeping consistent form. Progressive rate increases from 20 to 24 spm with rest between.

name: Beginner - Steady State - Short
description: Steady-state endurance row at a comfortable pace. Focus on maintaining consistent technique and breathing throughout.

name: Beginner - Drill Focus - Short
description: Technique-building session progressing through fundamental drills. Each 5-minute block isolates a different part of the stroke.

name: Beginner - Easy Intervals - Short
description: Gentle 2-minute on/off intervals alternating between moderate and easy pace. A great introduction to interval training.

name: Beginner - Pete Plan - Week 1
description: Entry point for the famous Pete Plan program. 20 minutes of steady state at low rate to build aerobic base. Focus on consistent split and pacing.

name: Beginner - Concept2 Two Tens
description: First sustained rowing effort from Concept2. Two 10-minute pieces build endurance and pacing awareness with a rest break between.

name: Beginner - Steady State - Medium
description: Extended steady-state row building aerobic base at low intensity. Ideal for developing endurance and a consistent rhythm.

name: Beginner - Drill Focus - Medium
description: Progressive drill session with 6-minute blocks for each stroke component. Longer segments allow deeper focus on each technique.

name: Beginner - Easy Intervals - Medium
description: Alternating 3-minute work and 2-minute recovery intervals. Builds fitness without overwhelming effort.

name: Beginner - Mixed Drills & Rowing - Long
description: Combines drill segments with free rowing to practice applying technique cues under normal conditions.

name: Beginner - Steady State - Long
description: Long steady-state session for building aerobic capacity. Maintain relaxed posture and consistent drive throughout.

name: Beginner - Drill Focus - Long
description: Comprehensive drill workout covering all fundamental stroke components in extended segments.

name: Beginner - Endurance Build - Long
description: Gradually increasing stroke rate over longer segments. Builds stamina while keeping intensity manageable.

name: Beginner - Easy Pyramid - Long
description: Ascending and descending stroke rate pyramid. Teaches pace control and body awareness at different intensities.

name: Intermediate - 30/30 Intervals
description: Ten 30-second sprints at 28 spm with equal rest. An introduction to anaerobic sprint work before stepping up to the advanced 30/30 sessions.

name: Intermediate - Interval 6x2min
description: Classic 6x2-minute interval workout with 60-second rest. A staple Concept2 format for building speed and power.

name: Intermediate - Concept2 1min On/Off
description: Classic Concept2 interval session. Alternating 1 minute hard and 1 minute easy for 10 rounds builds both aerobic and anaerobic capacity.

name: Intermediate - Intervals - Short
description: Work/rest intervals with higher stroke rates and tension. Develops power and cardiovascular fitness efficiently.

name: Intermediate - Pyramid - Short
description: Rate pyramid climbing and descending through stroke rates. Challenges pace discipline and power output control.

name: Intermediate - Steady State - Short
description: Compact steady row: 20 minutes at 24 spm and moderate tension. The short version of Steady State - Medium for busier days.

name: Intermediate - Pyramid with Rest
description: Duration pyramid climbing from 1 to 4 minutes and back down, with 60-second rest between steps. Combines endurance and interval training.

name: Intermediate - 4x4min Aerobic
description: Four 4-minute pieces at steady aerobic intensity with 2-minute rest. A classic Concept2 workout for building aerobic base.

name: Intermediate - Ascending Ladder 1-2-3-4-3-2-1
description: Classic pyramid ladder where work intervals ascend then descend. Rest is half the preceding work interval. Builds pacing awareness and mental toughness.

name: Intermediate - 3-2-1 Stroke Rate Pyramid
description: Pyramid cycling through 3-2-1 minute blocks at increasing stroke rates, repeated 4 times. Teaches rate changes and pacing discipline.

name: Intermediate - Fartlek Pickups
description: Steady 22 spm base broken by five 1-minute pickups at 26 spm, then a settled finish. A balanced everyday session mixing aerobic base with light speed work.

name: Intermediate - Pete Plan - Speed
description: Eight 2-minute speed intervals at 30 spm with 90-second rest. Approximates Pete Plan 500m rep sessions adapted for time-based rowing. Keep tension low — the stroke rate carries the intensity.

name: Intermediate - 10x90s On/Off
description: Ten 90-second work pieces alternating with 90-second rest. Equal work-to-rest ratio develops sustained high-intensity capacity.

name: Intermediate - 5x5min Threshold
description: Five 5-minute pieces at threshold pace with 60-second rest. Develops lactate threshold and sustained power output.

name: Intermediate - Negative Split 2x12
description: Two 12-minute pieces where the second is rowed harder than the first (22 then 24 spm). Teaches the negative-split pacing every race plan is built on.

name: Intermediate - Balanced 10x2:30
description: Ten 2:30 work intervals with short 30-second transitions. High volume with minimal rest builds aerobic power and mental endurance.

name: Intermediate - Intervals - Medium
description: Sustained work intervals at race-adjacent stroke rates with structured rest. Builds interval fitness and mental toughness.

name: Intermediate - Pyramid - Medium
description: Extended rate pyramid with longer steps. Tests ability to hold technique across a wide range of stroke rates.

name: Intermediate - Steady State - Medium
description: Moderate-intensity steady row at 24 spm. Builds aerobic power while maintaining good form.

name: Intermediate - Stroke Rate Wave
description: Wave pattern alternating between low, medium, and high stroke rates across 10 three-minute segments. Develops smooth rate transitions.

name: Intermediate - Ratings Ladder
description: Ascending stroke rate ladder stepping through 4, 3, 2, and 1-minute segments at increasing pace. Teaches rate control and smooth transitions.

name: Intermediate - Fat-Oxidation - Gemini
description: Optimized for fat burn on low-carb diets. Consistent, sustainable pressure.

name: Intermediate - Intervals - Long
description: Longer interval session with progressive intensity. Develops sustained power output and recovery capacity.

name: Intermediate - Pyramid - Long
description: Full ascending/descending pyramid across a wide stroke rate range. A thorough pace control challenge.

name: Intermediate - Endurance - Long
description: Extended moderate-intensity row building deep aerobic fitness. Focus on efficiency and relaxation at pace.

name: Intermediate - 3x12min Aerobic Build
description: Three 12-minute blocks at progressively increasing stroke rates. Develops aerobic endurance at threshold effort, simulating race-build strategy.

name: Intermediate - Endurance Hour - Gemini
description: Ultimate fat burner. Low stroke rate but high power per stroke.

name: Intermediate - The Long Slow Burn - Gemini
description: Ultimate fat-burning session for days when you have plenty of time.

name: Advanced - Tabata
description: True Tabata protocol: 8 rounds of 20s max effort / 10s rest. Short but brutally effective for anaerobic fitness.

name: Advanced - Lunch Break Tabata - Gemini
description: Extreme efficiency. 20s sprint / 10s rest format for max burn in minimal time.

name: Advanced - 30/30 Sprint Intervals
description: Short sprint intervals alternating 30 seconds of hard effort with 30 seconds of rest. Builds explosive power and anaerobic capacity.

name: Advanced - High-Low Split - Gemini
description: Alternating between very high tension (8) and moderate recovery to spike HR.

name: Advanced - HIIT 30/30 Sprint Blitz
description: Two rounds of 30-second max sprints with equal rest. 10 sprints then a break then 5 more. Builds explosive power and anaerobic capacity.

name: Advanced - Quick Power 20 - Gemini
description: Maximum tension intervals for a fast metabolic boost during work breaks.

name: Advanced - 8x1min Speed Intervals
description: Short high-intensity 1-minute intervals with generous 90-second rest. Builds speed and power with near-full recovery between efforts. Based on CrossFit rowing.

name: Advanced - Metabolic Wave - Gemini
description: Alternates low-intensity aerobic segments (20 spm) with high-intensity anaerobic surges (28 spm) every 3 minutes. Creates genuine metabolic and heart-rate swings instead of a flat effort.

name: Advanced - 2K Test
description: The classic erg benchmark: a 7-minute all-out piece at 32 spm and maximum tension, preceded by a full warmup with three race-pace bursts and an easy paddle. Log your result and retest every few weeks to track fitness.

name: Advanced - Power Intervals - Short
description: High-intensity intervals at elevated stroke rates and tension. Targets maximal power output in short bursts.

name: Advanced - Steady State Tempo
description: Continuation of the Intermediate Steady State - Medium: 20 minutes at 28 spm and moderate-high tension instead of 30 minutes at 24 spm. A tighter, harder tempo piece for days you only have half an hour.

name: Advanced - Speed Pyramid 5-4-3-2-1
description: Descending duration pyramid from 5 minutes down to 1 minute with increasing stroke rate. Builds speed as fatigue accumulates.

name: Advanced - Concept2 1min On/Off
description: Continuation of the Intermediate Concept2 1min On/Off: same equal-ratio work/rest format, raised from 28 spm to 32 spm with two extra rounds for greater sustained on/off capacity.

name: Advanced - 4x4min Threshold
description: Continuation of the Intermediate 4x4min Aerobic: same four 4-minute work blocks and 2-minute rest, raised from 22 spm/T4 to 26 spm/T6 for genuine threshold stress in the same 28-minute window.

name: Advanced - Sprint Pyramid - Short
description: Rate pyramid peaking once at 32 spm/T8, with recovery breaks scattered between every step (half the preceding work duration) instead of one lump rest. Develops top-end speed with built-in recovery throughout.

name: Advanced - Power Intervals - Gemini
description: High-intensity engine building.

name: Advanced - Two Tens
description: Continuation of the Beginner Concept2 Two Tens: same two 10-minute pieces and 3-minute rest between, raised from 22-24 spm to 26-28 spm and much higher tension. Endurance and pacing under real load, in under 30 minutes.

name: Advanced - 5000m Simulation - Gemini
description: Simulates a long-distance race pace with high resistance.

name: Advanced - 3-2-1 Stroke Rate Pyramid
description: Higher-rate continuation of the Intermediate 3-2-1 Stroke Rate Pyramid: same 3/2/1-minute block structure repeated 4 times, but climbing to 24/28/32 spm instead of 22/25/28. Reinforces rate-change discipline at advanced intensity.

name: Advanced - Fartlek Surges
description: Continuation of the Intermediate Fartlek Pickups: 24 spm base with five 1-minute surges at 30 spm and high tension. Aerobic volume with a real anaerobic sting.

name: Advanced - 12x30s Max Effort
description: Twelve 30-second bursts at maximum effort with generous 2-minute rest. Develops peak power and sprint repeatability.

name: Advanced - Negative Split 2x12
description: Continuation of the Intermediate Negative Split 2x12: the same two 12-minute pieces raised to 26 then 28 spm at high tension. Finishing faster when tired is the whole point.

name: Advanced - Balanced 10x2:30
description: Continuation of the Intermediate Balanced 10x2:30: same ten 2:30 work intervals and 30-second transitions, raised from 24 spm/T4 to 28 spm/T6 for real threshold stress at the same volume.

name: Advanced - Power Intervals - Medium
description: Extended high-power interval session with structured rest. Builds sustained power and lactate tolerance.

name: Advanced - Pyramid - Medium
description: Steep rate pyramid with tight transitions. Challenges cardiovascular capacity and stroke rate agility.

name: Advanced - Race Pace - Medium
description: Sustained race-pace rowing at 26-28 spm. Simulates competitive intensity for mental and physical preparation.

name: Advanced - Power Bursts - Medium
description: Ten rounds of 60-second max-effort bursts at 32 spm and top tension, with 2-minute recovery between. Long recovery windows let you go all-out each round.

name: Advanced - Stroke Rate Wave
description: Higher-rate continuation of the Intermediate Stroke Rate Wave: oscillates between 24 and 32 spm across eleven 3-minute segments instead of 20-28 spm. Trains rapid, controlled rate transitions at race-adjacent intensity.

name: Advanced - Power Endurance - Gemini
description: Heavy pulls at variable rates to force muscle recruitment.

name: Advanced - Ratings Ladder
description: Advanced continuation of the Intermediate Ratings Ladder: the same three-loop descending 4-3-2-1-minute structure ending in a sprint, but climbing to 24-32 spm instead of 20-28 spm. Rate control and repeatability under fatigue.

name: Advanced - Pete Plan - Long Intervals
description: Three 10-minute endurance intervals at 24 spm with 2.5-minute rest. Approximates Pete Plan 2000m pieces. Long enough to build real aerobic capacity, short enough to row harder than pure steady state.

name: Advanced - Waterfall 12-10-8
description: The classic Concept2 waterfall: 12, 10, and 8-minute pieces at rising stroke rates with 2-minute rests. The shrinking pieces let you push the pace as fatigue builds.

name: Advanced - Pete Plan - AT
description: Four 7-minute threshold pieces at 26 spm with 3-minute rest. Pete Plan anaerobic threshold work adapted for time-based rowing. Sustained effort that builds lactate threshold and aerobic power.

name: Advanced - Ascending Ladder 1-2-3-4-5-4-3-2-1
description: Extends the Intermediate Ascending Ladder 1-2-3-4-3-2-1 with a fifth rung, peaking at 5 minutes at 32 spm/T8 before descending. Rest is always half the preceding work interval: a longer, harder symmetric ladder for advanced pacing and mental toughness.

name: Advanced - Power Intervals - Long
description: Long high-intensity interval session. Demands sustained effort across many work bouts with disciplined recovery.

name: Advanced - Endurance - Long
description: Demanding steady-state row at elevated pace. Tests ability to hold technique and power over extended time.

name: Advanced - Race Simulation - Long
description: Full race simulation with progressive pace increases. Mimics the strategic pacing of a competitive 2k/5k race.

name: Advanced - Pyramid - Long
description: Grand pyramid covering the full stroke rate spectrum. The ultimate pace control and endurance challenge.

name: Advanced - The Step-Up 40 - Gemini
description: Increasing intensity every 10 minutes. A mental and physical grind.

name: Advanced - 3x12min Threshold Build
description: Continuation of the Intermediate 3x12min Aerobic Build: same three 12-minute blocks and 2-minute rest, climbing 24-26-28 spm instead of 20-22-24. Threshold-adjacent effort held over 36 minutes of work.

name: Advanced - Threshold 45 - Gemini
description: Long intervals at your upper aerobic limit. High calorie output.

name: Advanced - Endurance Hour
description: A full hour of sustained rowing: 50 minutes at 24 spm and moderate-high tension. Bridges the gap between the 46-minute sessions and Marathon Prep.

name: Advanced - Marathon Prep
description: The ultimate long steady-state test: 65 minutes at 22 spm and moderate-high tension. Direct continuation of the Intermediate Long Slow Burn, dialed up in rate and resistance for marathon-distance mental and physical preparation.
